heroSubtitle: Yi ajiyar wuraren zama na musamman da kuma sanin al'adu a Arewacin Najeriya da Jamhuriyar Nijar.
whyChoose1Desc: Daga gidajen iyali a Kano zuwa gidajen haya a Kaduna, sami ainihin kwarewar Arewa.
whyChoose2Desc: Bincika ta harshe, nemo gidaje kusa da kasuwanni da masallatai, kuma ka haɗu da masu masaukin baki.
whyChoose3Desc: Yi ajiyar gida cikin sauƙi ga iyali a gida ko nemo wurin hutu na gida tare da zaɓuɓɓukan biyan kuɗi masu sauƙi.
footerDescription: Gidanka a zuciyar Arewacin Najeriya da Sahel.
connectDescription: Shiga cikin al'ummarmu kuma ka kasance da masaniya.
